definitions.explanation: The quality of being beautiful. The noun form of the adjective {美|うつく}しい, used for visual, natural, and abstract beauty alike.

examples.japanese: {花|はな}の{美|うつく}しさに{驚|おどろ}いた。
examples.english: I was struck by the beauty of the flowers.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}の{歌声|うたごえ}の{美|うつく}しさに{聞|き}き{入|い}った。
examples.english: I listened intently, captivated by the beauty of her singing voice.

examples.japanese: {自然|しぜん}の{美|うつく}しさは{写真|しゃしん}では{伝|つた}えきれないことがある。
examples.english: The beauty of nature sometimes cannot be fully conveyed in photographs.

notes:
The noun form of the i-adjective {美|うつく}しい (beautiful), made with the {〜さ} suffix that turns adjectives into nouns naming the quality.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {美|うつく}しさに{驚|おどろ}く: be amazed at the beauty
- {自然|しぜん}の{美|うつく}しさ: the beauty of nature
- {美|うつく}しさを{保|たも}つ: maintain beauty

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {美|び}: beauty — a more abstract, formal noun (as in {美|び}を{追求|ついきゅう}する); {美|うつく}しさ feels more concrete and felt
